sources.quote: HD 136418 b, also known by its proper name Awasis, is an extrasolar planet orbiting the G-type star HD 136418 approximately 320 light years away in the constellation Boötes It has a notable orbit, staying within the known habitable zone.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 8.448 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,861 K, so 4.104 solar radii.
